systemic_note: Two systemic causes recur, both worse in 26.1.1 than in 26.1 because the 26.1.1 tree did NOT inherit the 26.1 tree's behaviour fixes (measured by file-by-file tree diff). (1) Class-table: 4 of 1.21.7's 9 renames carry to 26.1.1 with live arms dead — AbstractBed (B11-G01), RedstoneWire (B11-G02), Path (B11-G03), Speleothem (B11-G04) — all four 26.3 names present in the 26.3 jar and absent from both 26.1.1 jars; classes.rs is 0-diff vs 26.1's, still with NO dual names. Group B (StrawBed, SulfurSpike, ShelfMushroom, PotentSulfur) is 26.2/26.3-only content, harmless. (2) Tags/components: 26.1.1 HAS the 26.x tags the port reads (cauldron wash, chorus, mushroom light, snow-layer, convertable_to_mud all live in 26.1.1 data), so most of 1.21.7's tag-degradation defects do not apply; the two exceptions are 26.3-only tags the port reads — the potion tags (B11-G05) and speleothems (second cause of B11-G04). The component form of the same cause is NEW and worse: the tree reads cooking_fuel/brewing_fuel/compostable/villager_food/mob_visibility components 26.1.1 vanilla never defines (B11-G07's empty fuel list; Batch 4's B4-G01 furnaces, B4-G02 brewing, Batch 5's B5-G22 composter), where the 26.1 tree had restored the hardcoded tables. (3) F3: the spawn-counts abbreviations regressed to the 26.2+ form (B11-G09, NEW vs 26.1). RE-BASE WARNING: 26.1.1 is 26.x where 1.21.7 is not in eleven verified behaviours (trident passenger check, SwellGoal alive check, polar-bear fox age gate, lead-knot discard, mushroom/sapling bonemeal gates, golem stroll roll order, social gate, trader heightmap + SavedData storage, shipwreck heightAdjusted, players/data layout) — do not propagate 1.21.7 forms to 26.1.1. The 1e-5 fluid floor is present in both 26.1.1 vanilla (Entity constant pool) and the Rust. Three 26.1.1-vs-26.2 cautions: 26.1.1's F3 Mood literal is ONE-spaced while 26.2's is TWO-spaced, 26.1.1's spawn-counts abbreviations are single letters while 26.2's are two/three, and 26.1.1 vanilla HAS sound variants for cows/pigs/chickens/cats (1.21.7's A02 never existed here).
